title: Magnifique Bouzelouf
description: replace cooked mutton by a magnifique bouzelouf
body:
It's my first texture pack I made it for a friend but I decide to publish it for fun.It replace the cooked mutton by a magnifique bouzelouf (it's not a mutton head u can't place it)and also the name of the item.
Inspired from the bouzelouf from "la feuille des Aures".
